party.title: Christmas Party 2026
party.timeLong: 6 PM until the last power ballad

theme.name: Made in Canada
theme.pitch: Every gift has to be made in Canada, or be extremely Canadian. If it's from here, it counts.
examples: your kitchen is in Canada, so it counts
a bag of the good stuff
Candles, mugs, soap from a market
Any Canadian author, kids or grown-up
A tuque or mitts from a Canadian brand
theme.fineprint: Homemade counts. Close enough counts. A good gift that isn't Canadian still goes in the pile.

yankeeSwap.whoPlays: One combined game for kids and adults, so pick something anyone could enjoy.
yankeeSwap.finalNote: Keep it light, keep it kid-friendly, and remember: stealing is encouraged.

karaoke.pitch: New this year: karaoke! A whole new tradition, baby. Tell us if you're in, and send a song request or two.
